physics.astronomy.orbital_motion.name: Orbital Motion (Gravity)
physics.astronomy.orbital_motion.disclaimer: Two bodies, star fixed. Sizes not to scale. Blue: velocity; orange: the pull of gravity, always towards the star.

physics.astronomy.solar_system.name: The Solar System
physics.astronomy.solar_system.disclaimer: Not to scale: distances compressed (square-root scale) and planets hugely enlarged. Orbits drawn as circles; real ones are slightly elliptical. Periods are real.

physics.electromagnetism.electric_field.name: Electric Field
physics.electromagnetism.electric_field.disclaimer: Field lines in the plane of the charges. Red: positive charge; blue: negative.

physics.electromagnetism.magnetic_field_.name: Magnetic Field of a Wire
physics.electromagnetism.magnetic_field_.disclaimer: Conventional current flows upwards (arrow). Right-hand grip rule: thumb along the current, fingers curl the way the field circles.

physics.electronics.series_circuit.name: Series Circuit
physics.electronics.series_circuit.disclaimer: Dots show conventional current (+ to −); speed exaggerated. Real electrons drift the other way at about a millimetre per second.

physics.mechanics.circular_motion.name: Uniform Circular Motion
physics.mechanics.circular_motion.disclaimer: The velocity (blue) is along the circle; the acceleration (orange) points to the centre.

physics.mechanics.collision.name: Collisions and Momentum
physics.mechanics.collision.disclaimer: Frictionless track. Elasticity 1 = elastic (kinetic energy kept), 0 = the carts stick together.

physics.mechanics.free_fall.name: Free Fall
physics.mechanics.free_fall.disclaimer: No air resistance. Ghost balls show the position every 0.2 s: the gaps grow because the ball speeds up.

physics.mechanics.pendulum.name: Simple Pendulum
physics.mechanics.pendulum.disclaimer: No friction. Solved exactly (not the small-angle approximation), so large swings are slower.

physics.mechanics.projectile_motion.name: Projectile Motion
physics.mechanics.projectile_motion.disclaimer: No air resistance. Arrows: velocity (blue) and its horizontal and vertical components.

physics.mechanics.spring.name: Mass on a Spring
physics.mechanics.spring.disclaimer: No friction unless damping is set. The coil is drawn, not simulated.

physics.optics.reflection.name: Reflection of Light
physics.optics.reflection.disclaimer: Angles are measured from the normal, the line at right angles to the mirror.

physics.optics.refraction.name: Refraction of Light
physics.optics.refraction.disclaimer: A single ray. Part of the light is always reflected; above the critical angle, all of it is.

physics.waves.diffraction.name: Diffraction
physics.waves.diffraction.disclaimer: Huygens' principle: every point in the gap acts as a source. A gap about the size of the wavelength spreads the wave out most.

physics.waves.interference.name: Interference
physics.waves.interference.disclaimer: Ripples from two sources in step. Bright bands: constructive interference; flat bands: destructive.

physics.waves.sine_wave.name: Travelling Wave
physics.waves.sine_wave.disclaimer: A transverse wave on a string. The dot moves up and down only; the wave shape travels along.

physics.waves.standing_wave.name: Standing Wave
physics.waves.standing_wave.disclaimer: Fixed at both ends. Yellow dots mark nodes (no motion); the loops between them are antinodes.
